name: v2_inverse_aging_okane
description: Inverse problem on one aged-cell 1C discharge generated with PyBaMM's OKane2022 parameter set (synthetic cells of scripts/v2_make_aging_dataset.py and the LG M50 data set). OKane2022 applies a Bruggeman exponent 1.5 to the SOLID conductivities (Chen2020: 0), so the fresh cell of the PINN uses the effective values sigma_n = 215*0.75^1.5, sigma_p = 0.18*0.665^1.5 (otherwise a +1 mOhm lumped resistance is needed and 3-5 mV rms remain). Estimated: theta_n0, theta_p0 (LLI), eps_am_n, eps_am_p (LAM), R0. Data placed at t + ramp ln 2 (charge-equivalent alignment, dfn_pinn.v2.aging). The PINN includes PyBaMM's stress-enhanced diffusion D_k(c) = D_k (1 + theta_M_k c) with the OKane2022 mechanical parameters (theta_M_n 1.846e-5, theta_M_p 6.566e-3 m3/mol), which the degradation data set switches on by default (V2_RESULTS.md section 8).
